name: fable-advisor
description: A role pool: any model can be the main agent; two postures (orchestrating: deliverables only through a worker; implementing: the main agent may edit directly); explorer, worker, and advisor at mainstay, crux, and rescue tiers; grok, codex, claude, and handoff lanes named by mechanism; a fill table in the bundled routing profile maps (role, tier) to models. The advisor has decision and acceptance shapes; escalation climbs a ladder (rework ticket, then the next tier).
